title: Pay Operations Memorandum — Route Extension of the Cartwise Shopper Batches Long-Distance Bonus
content:
On Cartwise Shopper Batches the long-distance bonus grows with a long route as follows.

1. **Proportional extension.** When the estimated route exceeds the batch type's own long-distance threshold by **3.0 miles or more** and the shopper account carries **no late-delivery violation recorded against this batch**, the long-distance route extension grows the long-distance bonus amount in proportion to the route: it is the bonus amount multiplied by the estimated miles beyond the long-distance threshold that applies, divided by that threshold, **rounded down to the ten cents**.
2. **Per-mile extension.** When the route exceeds the batch type's own threshold by 3.0 miles or more and **one or more late-delivery violations are recorded against this batch**, the extension is only **0.10 for each whole estimated mile** beyond the long-distance threshold that applies, part miles not counted.
3. **No extension.** Otherwise the bonus stays the flat amount with no extension.

The bonus is then the flat bonus amount plus the extension.

## Two different thresholds

- The **3.0-mile test** is measured against the batch type's own long-distance threshold: 10.0 miles for the Single Delivery Batch, Double Delivery Batch and Triple Delivery Batch, 15.0 miles for the Stock-Up Batch (the Shop-Only Batch and Express 30 Batch carry a threshold of 0.0 and no bonus).
- The **extension itself** is measured beyond the long-distance threshold that applies to the shopper's batch.

Late-delivery violations are read from the shopper's Cartwise Shopper Contractor Accounts record, counting only those recorded against this batch.

## Matrix

| Route beyond the batch type's own threshold | Late-delivery violations against this batch | Extension |
|---|---|---|
| 3.0 miles or more | None | Bonus amount times miles beyond the applying threshold, divided by that threshold, rounded down to the ten cents |
| 3.0 miles or more | One or more | 0.10 per whole mile beyond the applying threshold |
| Less than 3.0 miles | Any | None |

## Worked figures (hypothetical batch)

A Single Delivery Batch (own threshold 10.0 miles) with an estimated route of 13.4 miles, where the threshold that applies is 10.0 miles and the bonus amount is 3.00:

- no late-delivery violation: 3.00 multiplied by 3.4, divided by 10.0, is 1.02, rounded down to the ten cents gives 1.00;
- one late-delivery violation: 3 whole miles beyond 10.0, multiplied by 0.10, gives 0.30;
- an estimated route of 12.9 miles is only 2.9 miles beyond 10.0, so no extension applies.

If the threshold that applies were 8.0 miles, the same 13.4-mile route (still 3.4 miles beyond the batch type's own 10.0) would give, with no late-delivery violation, 3.00 multiplied by 5.4, divided by 8.0, which is 2.025, rounded down to 2.00.
